credits.title: How was your day?
credits.overview: After a failed job interview, Selma spends her day at a shopping mall. As time seems to stand still, she aimlessly wanders through the stores. To those around her, she maintains a facade of normalcy, but the weight of her secret weighs heavily on her.

credits.title: Stiller
credits.overview: James Larkin White is arrested on his arrival at the Swiss border. He is accused of being the missing Swiss sculptor Anatol Stiller. The missing man, with whom he is mistaken, is accused of being involved in the “Smyrnov affair”.

credits.title: The Mies van der Rohes – A Female Family Saga
credits.overview: An epic family saga told by the women around the famous architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe.
